query: What financial losses have been caused by AI in finance?
summary: Search results indicate that AI-related financial losses in the sector involve increased fraud, operational risks, and potential systemic impacts, with specific figures varying between historical survey data and future projections.
findings: A survey of financial institutions found that 51% reported losing millions to AI-enabled crime in the past year (2023) [8].
Specific losses reported by these institutions ranged between $5 million and $25 million per year [8].
The Deloitte Center for Financial Services estimates generative AI email fraud losses could total about US$11.5 billion by 2027 in an aggressive adoption scenario [10].
60% of US companies reported increased fraud losses between 2024 and 2025 according to one source [6].
Banks and financial services firms with AI incidents have higher bankruptcy risk and lower operational cash flows compared to firms without such incidents [2].
AI-related risks include data breaches, cyber-attacks, and fraud which can cause financial losses and reputational damages eroding consumer trust [3].
